subject: token-release-corrections-framework

metrics.what: Measure the release of tokens into crypto ecosystems — corrections, attestations, compliance
metrics.gspc_integration: Every token release gets a GSPC measurement card — signed, anchored, corrections tracked
metrics.significance: First deterministic framework for measuring token releases and their corrections

honest_sentence: Token release measurement: pre-release (attestation, reserve, compliance, audit), release (on-chain, supply, holders, volume), post-release (price, reserves, corrections, compliance). Corrections tracked: Tethergate, MtGox, Celsius, FTX, Luna, RLUSD, USD1. GSPC: every release gets a signed card.
